install_values.WIN_USER: Windows account name, from --win-user or environment; prompted on an interactive install
install_values.PHD_ROOT: Full PhD parent folder; an absolute Mac path on macOS, WSL path on Windows. Required without a terminal or with --yes.
install_values.ONEDRIVE_ROOT: Parent of Documents, derived from PHD_ROOT
install_values.MAC_USER: Mac account name, from --mac-user, MAC_USER or the installing account; confirmed interactively
install_values.MAC_HOME: Installing Mac HOME; Mac setup also renders the historical WSL_HOME token to this path

reserved_privacy_placeholders.SIM_MACHINE: Simulation device name; informational placeholder, configured separately on the destination device
reserved_privacy_placeholders.GITHUB_USER: Repository owner, if a historical URL needs it
reserved_privacy_placeholders.TAILSCALE_IP: Private Tailscale address; supply on the destination device when needed
reserved_privacy_placeholders.TAILSCALE_HOST: Private Tailscale device name; supply on the destination device when needed
reserved_privacy_placeholders.TAILSCALE_PC: PC name or address; configured separately on the device
reserved_privacy_placeholders.TAILSCALE_MAC: Mac name or address; configured separately on the device
reserved_privacy_placeholders.KEY_FILE: Local SSH identity file path; never key contents

note: Windows renders WIN_USER, PHD_ROOT, WSL_HOME, LOCAL_ROOT and ONEDRIVE_ROOT. Mac renders MAC_USER, MAC_HOME, PHD_ROOT, LOCAL_ROOT and ONEDRIVE_ROOT, plus WSL_HOME as a compatibility alias. Mac sets COURSEWORK_ROOT in the installed config. Reserved network placeholders stay unrendered; archive is never installed.
